truth (issue #1118): a stopped() that cancels the save ticket (<ticket>.cancel()) and neither calls a station
save nor calls a helper that does drops the pending save: with a 5 s settle and one save per 60 s, a write made
inside the window before a restart or a servlet stop is never saved. WARN stop-drops-save on the cancel line
(exit 0: a warning, not a FAIL). The ticket scheduling itself (BStation.save) is no flush.

@DIR@/Mod
-- want --
exit 0
WARN  stop-drops-save  @DIR@/Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/BDashServlet.java:9  stopped() cancels the pending save ticket without a flush: a write made inside the settle window before a restart or a servlet stop is never saved; read !saveTicket.isExpired() before cancel() and call station.save() in a try/catch that logs (types/dashboard.md § Write path)
-- stderr --
-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/BDashServlet.java --
package com.x.ux;
public final class BDashServlet extends BWebServlet {
  private final Object saveLock = new Object();
  private Clock.Ticket saveTicket = Clock.expiredTicket;
  void requestSave(BStation station, long delay) {
    saveTicket = Clock.schedule(station, BRelTime.make(Math.max(delay, 1L)), BStation.save, null);
  }
  @Override public void stopped() throws Exception {
    synchronized (saveLock) { saveTicket.cancel(); }
    super.stopped();
  }
}
